from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from .models import WBSNode

class ReorderTaskNodeView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request, node_id):
        node = get_object_or_404(WBSNode, id=node_id, project__manager=request.user)
        target_sibling_id = request.data.get("target_sibling_id")
        target_sibling = get_object_or_404(WBSNode, id=target_sibling_id, project=node.project)

        node.move(target_sibling, pos="right")
        return Response({"status": "node_reordered", "node_id": node.id})
